title: Annual Average Study
description: This template is based on the average day speeds for the latest year. It provides average speeds by five minute epoch, by peak period, by day of week, by month, and compares the latest year to the 3 preceding years.
_note:
Reconstructed via --from-page 2210458. Dates were already correctly live (startDate=>yearof / year-Nyear->1year, derived from __TODAY__) from the 2026-08-10 round — unlike Single Route/Year Over Year/etc, THIS template's claimed fix actually held up. Real reduction found: of 10 original comps, 6 (AM Peak/PM Peak/Off Peak/Day-of-Week/Avg-by-Day/Avg-by-Month, all narrower time-windows of the SAME 'Current Year' route) are orphaned comp ids no longer in the live route array — consolidated away at some point, presumably when Design Push #2 moved weekday/start/end filtering from the route onto the graph, since a route-level time-of-day sub-view no longer has a home. Reassigned each affected graph to 'Current Year' by title intent (day-of-week/by-day/by-month breakdowns still work fine on one route, just grouped differently) EXCEPT the 'Bar Graph Summary' comparing AM/PM/Off-Peak as 3 bars — that capability is genuinely gone now (a Bar Graph Summary's bars are different ROUTES, and there's only one real route left; peak-hour comparison would need per-GRAPH windows, which can't produce multiple bars off one route) — dropped rather than built as a meaningless 1-bar chart.

CORRECTED 2026-08-12, Ryan's live review against the old tool: (1) the Line Graph is re-scoped to show 1 line per year (Current + 1/2/3 Years Ago, no peak filter) instead of just Current Year alone — Ryan's own call, strictly better than the unbuildable peak-based original. (2) Found + fixed a real, systemic report_build.mjs bug: `isGraphSectionElement()` only recognized a Route Compare/Info Box section if it carried a `_routeComparePick`/`_infoBoxPick` marker that convert_old_reports.py (confirmed via grep: zero hits anywhere in convert_old_reports_lib) never stamps — so any such section the Python converter successfully built was completely invisible to `--from-page`, silently dropped from every reconstructed spec with no warning at all (worse than the AVL Graph case, which at least gets `_needsReview`). Fixed by matching structure instead (the same self-bound `comparison_series`/`$self` subscriber the live runtime's own `findSelfBoundGraphs` uses, plus a `type:'delta'` column as the Route-Compare-vs-Info-Box tell). Confirmed via the old template's own raw `admin2.templates.graph_comps` (id 278) that TWO Route Compare Component panels existed and were successfully converted by the original 2026-08-07 run (its own gap log shows `extra_measures_dropped` activity for both) — neither survived into this spec. Recovered by rebuilding a throwaway scratch page straight from the old template (`convert_old_reports.py --template-id 278`, a separate slug, deleted after use) and re-running the now-fixed `--from-page` against it. Added back the buildable one: `compare_years` (Current Year vs 1/2/3 Years Ago, real distinct routes, no blockers). The other (`graph-comp-8`, Current Year vs AM/PM/Off-Peak-filtered Current Year) is NOT buildable — its 3 compare arms are the same orphaned peak-filtered comps that already collapsed into 'Current Year', so today it would just compare one route to itself; blocked on the same not-yet-built per-route-window-override architecture as the peak-based Bar Graph Summary. Both Route Compare panels' second measure (Travel Time) is also dropped — `ROUTE_COMPARE_MEASURES`/Route Compare's spec grammar is single-measure-per-graph today, same not-yet-built multi-measure gap already scoped for Info Box. This bug is very likely systemic across the other 11 templates too (same reconstruction pipeline, same marker blindness) — audit deferred, explicitly NOT run yet, per Ryan's direction to finish finding every issue on THIS template first rather than re-running all 12 per bug found.
